experimental.classicWorkspace.descriptio.en: Use the previous workspace instead of the standard Coordinator workspace. This changes your interface across companies on this instance.
experimental.classicWorkspace.descriptio.zh-CN: 使用旧版工作区替代标准的 Coordinator 工作区。此设置将更改你在此实例所有公司中的界面。

experimental.classicWorkspace.footnote.en: Off by default. Turn it off to return to Coordinator. Your work and your teammates’ settings stay the same.
experimental.classicWorkspace.footnote.zh-CN: 默认关闭。将其关闭即可返回 Coordinator。你的工作内容和团队成员的设置保持不变。

experimental.classicWorkspace.loading.zh-CN: 正在加载你的偏好设置…

experimental.classicWorkspace.localBoard.en: This local instance uses the shared Local Board identity.
experimental.classicWorkspace.localBoard.zh-CN: 此本地实例使用共享的“本地董事会”身份。

experimental.combinedInboxTasks.descript.en: In the Classic workspace, fold Inbox into Tasks. One Tasks row carries the unread badge, and a Views menu reaches every personal and organization task view.
experimental.combinedInboxTasks.descript.zh-CN: 在经典工作区中将收件箱折叠进任务列表。“任务”入口统一显示未读角标，并通过“视图”菜单访问所有个人和组织任务视图。

experimental.combinedInboxTasks.footnote.en: Coordinator always includes personal views in Tasks. For Classic, turning this off restores its separate Inbox. No data changes.
experimental.combinedInboxTasks.footnote.zh-CN: Coordinator 始终在“任务”中包含个人视图。对于经典工作区，关闭此项将恢复独立的收件箱。不会更改任何数据。

experimental.googleWorkspaceConnector.ar.en: Toggle Paperclip Google Workspace connector experimental setting
experimental.googleWorkspaceConnector.ar.zh-CN: 切换 Paperclip Google Workspace 连接器实验功能设置

experimental.googleWorkspaceConnector.de.en: Show the built-in Google Workspace connector for Gmail, Drive, and Calendar while Google verification is pending.
experimental.googleWorkspaceConnector.de.zh-CN: 在等待 Google 审核期间，显示用于 Gmail、Drive 和 Calendar 的内置 Google Workspace 连接器。

experimental.googleWorkspaceConnector.fo.en: Off by default. While off, Google apps are offered through Composio and Arcade instead, and the built-in connector cannot be set up or run.
experimental.googleWorkspaceConnector.fo.zh-CN: 默认关闭。关闭期间，Google 应用改为通过 Composio 和 Arcade 提供，内置连接器无法配置或运行。

experimental.grokBot.ariaLabel.zh-CN: 切换 Grok Bot 实验功能设置

experimental.grokBot.description.en: Connect an existing Grok Bot as an agent. Verify routine delivery and an authenticated reply before assigning work.
experimental.grokBot.description.zh-CN: 将现有的 Grok Bot 连接为智能体。在分配任务前，请验证例行送达和已认证回复。

experimental.grokBotRequirements.en: Requires Paperclip Runner and authenticated public HTTPS. Usage is not reported. Turning this off blocks Grok calls and new dispatch.
experimental.grokBotRequirements.zh-CN: 需要 Paperclip Runner 和已认证的公共 HTTPS。不会报告用量。关闭后会阻止 Grok 调用和新的调度。

experimental.legacyComposerSubmit.ariaLa.zh-CN: 切换 Command/Ctrl+Enter 提交快捷键

experimental.legacyComposerSubmit.descri.en: Restore the previous keyboard shortcut for task replies and new tasks: Command/Ctrl+Enter submits, and Enter adds a new line.
experimental.legacyComposerSubmit.descri.zh-CN: 恢复任务回复和新建任务的旧版快捷键：Command/Ctrl+Enter 提交，Enter 换行。

experimental.legacyComposerSubmit.footno.en: Off by default: Enter submits, and Shift+Enter adds a new line.
experimental.legacyComposerSubmit.footno.zh-CN: 默认关闭：Enter 提交，Shift+Enter 换行。

experimental.muse.ariaLabel.zh-CN: 切换 Muse 实验功能设置

experimental.muse.description.en: Connect your personal Meta Muse. Pair it, detect its receiver, and verify an independent background reply before assigning tasks.
experimental.muse.description.zh-CN: 连接你的个人 Meta Muse。在分配任务前，请完成配对、检测接收器并验证独立后台回复。

experimental.muse.footnote.en: Requires Paperclip Runner and an authenticated instance with a public HTTPS URL. Turning this off blocks new work; cleanup and stop evidence remain available. Provider usage and cost are unavailable.
experimental.muse.footnote.zh-CN: 需要 Paperclip Runner 以及带有公网 HTTPS URL 的已认证实例。关闭后将阻止新任务派发；清理与停止凭据仍可使用。提供方用量与费用不可用。
